title: mmz manifest
description: Configuration for mmz, the memoized command runner.

scopes.description: Named glob sets, each referenced by command rules.

commands.description: Ordered command rules; the first token-prefix match wins.

inputs.description: Scope names whose globs union into this rule's input set.

match.description: How name matches argv. prefix (default): name's tokens are a leading slice of the command. exact: the whole command equals name's tokens.

on_hit.description: Overrides the top-level on_hit for this rule. An empty string suppresses the cache-hit notice.

gitignore.description: Skip git-ignored paths when expanding globs.

cache_dir.description: Directory for throwaway cache records, relative to the project root (the directory holding .mmz); an absolute path is used as-is. Must be git-ignored.

strict.description: Runtime cases mmz errors on instead of falling back to passthrough. Omit the key for all cases (the default); list a subset to relax the rest; use [] to fall back everywhere.

on_hit.description: Message printed to stderr when a command is skipped (a cache hit). Macros: {cache:<field>} substitutes a field from the matched rule's cache record (e.g. command, ran_at, input_digest). An empty string prints nothing; a command's own on_hit overrides this.
